candidates.structural_interaction: Fire directing Metal cross-polarity — focused warmth shaping the edge with discipline
candidates.k2_overview: Your Metal moves as the Steward: an edge in service of what it keeps. You maintain value with a craftsman’s discipline, tools oiled, accounts true, promises weighed before signing. Nothing gaudy, everything durable. What passes through your hands leaves better organized, and what stays becomes quietly excellent.

k2_functional.mind: You think in maintenance schedules: what needs truing before it breaks.
k2_functional.expression: You speak in accurate commitments: dates kept, numbers exact, words engraved.
k2_functional.bonds: You keep people the way you keep good tools: carefully, long, with respect.
k2_functional.action: You execute with clean precision: zero waste, nothing reworked, every screw accounted for.
k2_functional.body: Your health runs on maintenance: tuned habits, regular checks, quality inputs.

k2_domain_readings.Wealth: Your wealth is machined: earned exactly, kept polished, compounded without drama. You will never be flashy and never be broke. Invest in quality that holds its edge, including your own skills.
k2_domain_readings.Savings: You save like an armorer: reserves as protection, kept bright and counted. The vault serves the life, so define what it defends, and spend without guilt inside those lines.
k2_domain_readings.Steady love: You love in maintained condition: reliability, kept promises, care with no rust on it. Choose someone who values upkeep, then schedule delight as faithfully as inspections.
